title: A parcel for a neighbour
instructions: Bir kurye komşu için paket bırakmak istiyor. Kısa bir diyalog; kimin için olduğuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hi. I have a parcel for number twelve, but nobody is home. Could you take it?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Sure. That's Mr Lee. He's at work until six.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Thanks. Can you sign here, please?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Of course. I'll give it to him this evening.

questions.prompt: Which house is the parcel for?
questions.evidence: I have a parcel for number twelve

questions.feedback: On iki numarada Bay Lee oturuyor.

questions.prompt: When does Mr Lee come home?
